name: U7-Pro
title: Access Point U7 Pro
summary: Ceiling WiFi 7 tri-band 6-stream AP with 2.5GbE uplink; mainstream UniFi workhorse.

requires: UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (8.0.28+)

gotchas: Needs PoE+ (21W) — 802.3af ports (US-8-60W, UDR-5G-Max's single PoE port) won't power it.
2.5GbE uplink is wasted on 1GbE switches (USW-16-PoE, USW-Pro-24-PoE); pair with a 2.5G PoE switch.
2x2 per band; for denser rooms/spectral scanning step up to U7 Pro Max or E7.
6 GHz only helps WiFi 6E/7 clients; requires a UniFi console to adopt.
best_for: homes/offices wanting WiFi 7 at modest cost
